description:
## [1.7.0](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/compare/v1.6.1...v1.7.0) (2026-11-10)

### ✨ New Features

* guard NoBrokerHood notification click browser routes ([17d7737](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/commit/17d7737b24ac83160760add5a3e9d00520bc1d98))

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Default browser, block known ad hosts (experimental)
patches.description: Keep default-browser support but block known Multipl and Innovid ad-tracking hosts.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide app-bar banners (experimental)
patches.description: Empty app-bar banner entries; may leave a layout placeholder.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide app-bar island row (test)
patches.description: Skip the AppBarIsland.kt horizontal row. May hide non-ad items.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide app-bar response cards (experimental)
patches.description: Remove app-bar advertising card data before creating banner state.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide default post-approval card (experimental)
patches.description: Hide the fallback ad card after entry approval. Null handling is untested.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide expanded notification images (experimental)
patches.description: Hide large banner images in entry/exit notifications while retaining text (3.6.11).

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide floating promotional sidebar
patches.description: Hide the SideAd.kt Compose renderer attached to the RIGHT_AD home section.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide home-discover carousel (experimental)
patches.description: Hide cards in the homepage discover carousel; may hide non-ad items too.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide homepage billboard
patches.description: Hide the homepage top billboard by clearing TopAdState during construction.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide homepage top ads (experimental)
patches.description: Supply an empty top-ad list and disable its loading/expanded state.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide island promotional strip (experimental)
patches.description: Hide homepage items marked ISLAND_BANNER; test against the blue Domino's strip.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide post-approval ad card (experimental)
patches.description: Hide the sponsored card shown after entry approval or pre-approval (3.6.11).

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide post-approval multimedia ads
patches.description: Suppress image, GIF, video and Lottie ad cards after approval, without blocking the approval status.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide promotional side tab (experimental)
patches.description: Suppress the draggable multimedia promotion card; verify on-device.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Stop full-screen permission nag
patches.description: Stop the home-screen full-screen alert reminder without changing permissions.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Stop promotional browser launches from notifications
patches.description: Prevent notification-triggered browser ad routes; retain security alerts and in-app event metadata (experimental).
